test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In 2024, India introduced a fast-track procurement clause in which defence procurement policy to reduce acquisition delays?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Acquisition Procedure**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020 introduced various reforms, including a fast-track procurement clause to address delays in acquiring critical defence equipment.
 
• In 2024, India emphasized this clause to expedite the procurement process for enhancing operational readiness of the armed forces.
 
• Fast-track procurement is aimed at addressing urgent operational requirements during critical situations or emergencies.
 
• The Defence Acquisition Procedure replaced the earlier Defence Procurement Procedure (DPP) and focuses on indigenization under the "Atmanirbhar Bharat" initiative.
 
• The DAP 2020 incorporates numerous measures to promote transparency, efficiency, and accountability in defence acquisitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP):**

 
 
• It is a comprehensive document that governs the acquisition of defence equipment, systems, and platforms in India.
 
• DAP 2020 emphasizes "Make in India" and self-reliance in the defence sector by encouraging domestic manufacturing.
 
• It classifies procurement into categories such as Buy (Indian-IDDM), Buy (Indian), Buy and Make (Indian), and others to prioritize indigenous production.
 
 
 
• **Fast-Track Procurement:**
 
 
• This mechanism was introduced to meet critical operational needs of the armed forces within a compressed timeline.
 
• It is used in situations of urgency, bypassing lengthy procurement procedures.
 
 
 
• **Indigenization in Defence:**
 
 
• The government aims to achieve self-reliance in defence manufacturing through initiatives like "Atmanirbhar Bharat" and the Strategic Partnership Model.
 
• Efforts are being made to reduce India's reliance on defence imports and promote exports of indigenous defence products.
 
 
 
• **Defence Offset Policy:**
 
 
• This policy mandates foreign vendors to invest a percentage of the contract value in India to develop the domestic defence industry.
 
• It supports technology transfer and collaboration between Indian and foreign defence companies.
